TerrainDef.label: void-ash metal
TerrainDef.description: A dead matte field of ash-choked black industrial plating, scraped by old excavation scars.

TerrainDef.label: fractured dominion plate
TerrainDef.description: Cracked hellsteel slabs from a collapsed machine-basilica, blackened by pressure and soot rather than flame.

TerrainDef.label: void-channel conduit
TerrainDef.description: Subdued violet conduits cut through the black platework, carrying the Dominion's dead signal beneath the floor.

TerrainDef.label: dominion lock-plate
TerrainDef.description: Dense circular lock-plating used around the heart and anchor points, more like a sealed industrial interface than a magical seal.

TerrainDef.label: dominion fissure-stressed floor
TerrainDef.description: Corrupted ash-metal plating stressed by nearby Dominion hemoplasm fissures. It is floor support scarring, not an open rupture.
